drafts.title: Forty Feet

drafts.title: Swimming
drafts.pitch: Cursor verifies the plaque, then the user asks if the lake is good for swimming. Another version of Naomi's idea (issue #66).
drafts.reason: Cleanest read and 'Of air.' is a crisp button, but the invented swimming question pulls away from the pitch, and Cursor's 'Technically?' is filler.
